ROOT.scriptdef: if exists (select name from sysobjects where name = 'POS_EksportLayouty' and type = 'P') drop procedure CDN.POS_EksportLayouty;

CREATE PROCEDURE [CDN].[POS_EksportLayouty] @RowVersion BIGINT, @PointOfSaleId INT AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON; declare @slwId int = (select top 1 slw_id from CDN.Slowniki where SLW_Kategoria = 'Typy załączników' AND SLW_WartoscS = 'Profile POS')
select isnull((select MAX(DAB_CzasDodania) from cdn.PicoStanowiskaOperatorzy join cdn.OpeKarty on Ope_GIDNumer = PKn_OpeNumer join cdn.StaKarty on Ope_StaNumer = Sta_GIDNumer join CDN.DaneBinarne on DAB_OpeNumer = Sta_GIDNumer where PKn_PSaID = @pointOfSaleId AND DAB_TypId = @slwId),@RowVersion) as [@RowVersion], (
select distinct dab_id as[@Id], dab_nazwa as [@Name] from cdn.PicoStanowiskaOperatorzy join cdn.OpeKarty on Ope_GIDNumer = PKn_OpeNumer join cdn.StaKarty on Ope_StaNumer = Sta_GIDNumer join CDN.DaneBinarne on DAB_OpeNumer = Sta_GIDNumer where PKn_PSaID = @pointOfSaleId AND (DAB_CzasDodania > @RowVersion OR @RowVersion=0) AND DAB_TypId = @slwId for xml path('Layout'), type) for xml path('Layouts') SET NOCOUNT OFF; END
GRANT EXECUTE ON CDN.POS_EksportLayouty TO CDNRaport
